title: Hinomori Shizuku — Trial Skin Care Routine〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all for gathering here today.
I hope we have a good stream rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That includes you, Saito.
Haruka just couldn't make it today, so I really appreciate you filling in for her.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, don't thank me. I doubt I'll be able to fill her shoes, but I promise to do my best to help out!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for saying that. But we're just doing a table read today, so please try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, since everything's ready, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Saito
rows.Line: It's back!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: The MORE MORE Skincare Segment!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all for tuning in to our stream today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Today, we'll be doing another skincare segment since it got such a good response last time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll begin by interviewing the others about how they each take care of their skin. Then, I'll present a few products that I recommend and finish the stream by taking questions from everyone watching.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin the interview!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. Now, I know we all treat our skin differently depending on what sort of condition it's in. So, I'd like to hear what sort of things you all take into account.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, the products I use tend to differ based on the time of year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, during summer when it's humid, I try to use things that are less sticky. But I'll switch to more moisturizing products when the air becomes drier.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too. I use moisturizing creams during winter to make sure my skin doesn't get all dry and flaky!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, it is important to adjust as the seasons change. Doing so can solve a lot of skin problems.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I agree.
Why don't we use this opportunity to consider some new options for when our skin isn't behaving the way we want?

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Saito
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Alright, we'll end the interview portion here...
Next, I'll present some skincare products that I really recommend.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We need to get some things ready for the next segment, so you'll need to excuse us for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be right back, you guys!
se_walk_women_005_1
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do our best without them in the meantime, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yeah, we've got this.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This time around, Shizuku... You're, uhh... Going to showcase some skincare products for us that you really recommend, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. I tried quite a few and separated the ones I thought were the best into two categories.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, let's begin with the light set.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These are lighter products that absorb quickly. We'll begin with some facial toner.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I recommend this set very much for those who aren't exactly fans of products that leave your skin feeling sticky.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll tell everyone about the products in the moisturization set.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Let's see... This set focuses on moisturizing your skin, and we'll start with a face serum.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This set does its job really well, so I recommend it to those with skin that tends to become flaky and scaly when the air is really dry.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But, to understand the benefits of each set, it might be best to try out both since they have such different purposes in mind!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. So, why don't we ask the other two to join us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi! Minori!
se_walk_women_005_2
se_walk_women_005_3

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
We're back! And with no makeup on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We will be the ones testing these sets out in order to see if they really work! We're calling this portion of the program...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Minori
rows.Line: The MORE MORE No Makeup Test!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Saito
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For this test, we'll be having these two use one of the sets we just mentioned on one half of their faces, and one on the other.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'd greatly appreciate it if you could both talk about how each feels different and what you think about them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, no problem!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I'll begin with the light set!
Start with the facial toner and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...! This stuff goes on so smoothly...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, and...
It feels like my skin's absorbing it so fast!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like you immediately noticed the benefits. Next, if you two could try the moisturizing set.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're supposed to start with this serum, right?
I'll take a normal amount, and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This texture... Moisturized doesn't begin to describe this sensation!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My skin feels way softer than normal now...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Then... Lemme see for myself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Pinch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Fwah?!
Fwairi, fwhat are you fooing?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You're right. Your skin feels way softer than normal. This stuff's amazing, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad you're both enjoying this set so much. Thank you again for agreeing to do this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll post the sets we presented today on social media later, so we hope you get a chance to try them out yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Next, it's time for a Q&A.
Please feel free to post any questions that you'd like us to answer in the chat.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Okay, let's see... For our first question...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's it for this rehearsal. What did you all think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That went pretty well. Your explanation was really good, and seeing really is believing as far as the test portion goes.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Saito.
You did a wonderful job of filling in for Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: R-Really?! Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now we just have to see what Haruka thinks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Once she gives the green light, then we should be all set to go with this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After she does, I'll do my best to polish up what I can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness my stream idea came together so nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This should give our group a bit of a boost.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And I'd like to keep doing what I can moving forward.)
